causal_divergence: (1) The packet emits the cluster comment for every group painted by emit_root_state_cluster. render_non_autarkic_root_clusters is entered for root groups that Java treats as autarkic (1162 R3/O3, 1164 SharedGate593/OuterShell593), so Rust adds comments Java never produces. (2) endpoint_parent_scope only knows the [*] prefix; [H]Top.Lower and [H*]Top.Lower have no parent scope, so the transition [*] --> [H] looks like it crosses Lower's boundary and Lower/Top are wrongly non-autarkic (state_history_nested_identity). (3) emit_autonomous_scope_links shortens [H]Top.Lower to Lower with autonomous_endpoint_svg_name before state_comment_endpoint can recognise the marker, so comments read 'Lower' instead of '*historical*Lower'. (4) autonomous_group_is_autarkic omits isAutarkic's direct-leaf EntityPosition clause.
